ways.label: Diamond Harbour wharf to Mount Herbert/Te Ahu Pātiki summit
evidence: The track starts from the Te Waipapa/Diamond Harbour wharf.
Very near the summit, a junction indicates 10 minutes left to continue to the summit, or 15 minutes right to the shelter.
Either return the same way you came, or continue left on to the Port Levy Saddle and from there to the Rod Donald Hut in 3 hr 20 min.

doubts: No feature for the Diamond Harbour wharf; T9 is the bay (coast) rather than the wharf, so the start has no ref. Bayview Road ref F1 is the only track/Bayview Road junction listed; the text says it is the last place within Diamond Harbour to start the track. The shelter is 15 minutes right from a junction near the summit and is not on the way to the summit; recorded as a side trip. Onward routes to Rod Donald Hut, Packhorse Hut and other exits are continuations, not ways of this walk.
